karta: Every new window gets a card. Choose the dashboard and place.
pasek: All windows, reason for each move and history in one place.
assist: Windows listen to commands, e.g. “close the living room”.
ukryj: Assist only sees Motor HA windows, no duplicate names.
powiadom: When something is wrong with a shade or sensor.

karta: When you add a window, Motor HA puts its card on the chosen dashboard, view and place. It never removes or moves anything. If the card is already there, it does nothing.
The card is not put on any dashboard. Add it yourself: Edit dashboard → Add card → Motor HA.
dom: The dashboard chosen for the window card gets one card with all windows of the home: the state of each window and open, stop, close buttons.
No whole-home card, only cards of single windows.
skroty: Above the window cards there are three buttons for the whole home. Pause stops the automation of all windows for 2 hours.
No buttons; you control the whole home from the “Whole home” card or by voice.
pasek: The HA sidebar gets a “Motor HA” item: all windows with their cards, the reason for the last move, the move history and these settings.
No sidebar item. You find the windows in Settings → Devices → Motor HA.
assist: Motor HA windows are visible to Assist under their name and room, e.g. “close the living room”, “open the kitchen window”.
Assist does not see Motor HA windows; you control them from the card and the automation.
ukryj: The plain motors Motor HA windows are made from are hidden from Assist. Voice does not mix up “living room blind” and “living room window”.
Assist sees both the motor and the Motor HA window (there may be two similar names).
powiadom: You get a message when a motor does not respond, a shade did not reach its position, a battery is low or the automation could not move a shade (e.g. because of an open window).
No messages. You see the state on the card and in the window history.
auto: Every window gets the scenarios below. They work in order of importance: a higher one wins over or limits a lower one. You can change each later in “Configure” of the window.
Shades only move when you say so: card, voice, button or your own HA automations. Motor HA does nothing on its own.
nowa_wersja: After every update this screen appears with “What's new” and your settings to check.
Updates without this screen. “What's new” is only in HACS.

ekran.scenOpis: All scenarios in order of importance (1 is the most important). A scenario without the sensor it needs skips itself. You can turn each off:

cisza: for 5 minutes after an HA restart shades stay still until the sensors report their state
dym: smoke detector → the shade opens (escape route and light)
wiatr: wind from 40 km/h or vibration → the outdoor shade retracts; hail warning → awning retracted, shutter closed (protects the glass)
deszcz: awnings, screens and external venetian blinds retract; shutters stay as they are
mroz: at 1 °C and below the outdoor shade does not move (it may be frozen)
pauza: when you move the shade yourself, the automation waits 2 hours
alarm: when the alarm is armed, the shade closes
spie: “Sleeping” switch on → the shade stays closed and does not open in the morning
nikogo: nobody home → the shade is closed; in vacation mode it moves at a slightly different time every morning and evening
rano: at sunrise (or at the time you set) the shade opens
wieczor: at sunset (or at the time you set) the shade closes
obecnosc: Wait for someone in the morning
until 10:00 the shade opens only when someone enters the room
posrednia: from 13:00 the shade stays at 50 % instead of fully open
slonce: the sun shines into this window and it is 24 °C or more outside (or heat is forecast) → the shade goes down to 20 % open
oslepianie: sun in the window → the shade goes down so the sun reaches no further than 3 m into the room (e.g. to the TV or desk)
pokoj: 25 °C or more in the room and sun in the window → the shade goes to 20 % open
zima: from November to March the shade is open in the sun (free heat) and closed at night (less heat loss)
okno: tilted window: the shade does not go lower than 20 %; open window: it does not go down; open balcony door: not lower than 80 %
przeszkoda: obstacle sensor at the balcony door → the shade does not go down
granice: the shade never goes beyond the limits you set; blind slats turn to the angle of the sun
